events.verdict: Curry (GSW) and Dunn (LAC) come together off-ball and marginal contact occurs as Curry releases away from Dunn.
Payton II (GSW) firms up over his right leg in Dunn's (LAC) path and does not delivery any illegal contact when setting the pick.
Dunn (LAC) legally contests Curry's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Payton II (GSW) places and promptly removes his left hand from Harden's  (LAC) back during his driving shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Leonard (LAC) comes together with Curry (GSW) as he gathers the pass and the resulting body contact is marginal.
Podziemski's (GSW) arms momentarily come around Leonard (LAC) as Leonard attempts to defend over the pick and the marginal contact dissolves shortly  thereafter.
Podziemski (GSW) gathers the ball and takes more than two steps.
Green (GSW) momentarily grasps and releases Zubac's (LAC) jersey off-ball and the marginal contact dissolves shortly thereafter.
Butler III (GSW) steps towards Leonard (LAC) and marginal contact occurs prior to Leonard starting his dribble.
Green (GSW) reaches back as Zubac (LAC) receives the lob pass and the contact with his arm during the dunk is marginal.
Powell (LAC) rests and removes his right hand from Butler III's (GSW) side and the contact as Butler III controls the pass is marginal.
Butler III's (GSW) hands come out slightly from his body as he firms up in Dunn's (LAC) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Powell (LAC) brings his hand forward and marginal brush contact occurs with Curry's (GSW) front during his drive into the paint.
Curry's (GSW) off-arm briefly comes around Powell's (LAC) side and the marginal contact dissolves shortly thereafter during Curry's drive into the paint.
Curry (GSW) and Leonard (LAC) come together as Leonard corrals the loose ball and marginal contact occurs prior to Leonard releasing his pass.
Leonard (LAC) releases the ball prior to his feet coming down out of bounds.
Harden (LAC) releases the ball prior to five seconds elapsing after receiving the ball from the game official.
Green (GSW) momentarily places and swiftly removes his hands from Leonard's (LAC) front during his drive and the contact is marginal.
Green (GSW) reaches in for the ball and body contact occurs with Leonard (LAC), which affects his SQBR with the ball.
Green (GSW) briefly grasps and promptly releases the front of Leonard's (LAC) jersey and the contact during the inbound play is marginal.
Payton II (GSW) comes together with Harden (LAC) as Harden moves towards Green (GSW) and the contact as Harden cuts past Green is marginal.
Green (GSW) contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt and the brush contact after the release is marginal.
Green (GSW) contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Butler III (GSW) and Zubac (LAC) engage as the shot travels through the air and the contact during the rebounding opportunity is marginal.
Harden (LAC) brings his left hand towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Curry's (GSW) arm as he dribbles the ball towards the three-point arc.
Harden (LAC) momentarily rests his right hand on Curry's (GSW) side as his left arm makes deflects Curry's pass. Harden's brief contact with Curry's side is marginal.
Dunn (LAC) firms up over his left leg and marginal contact occurs as he comes together with Payton II (GSW) during the pick.
Payton II (GSW) briefly rests his right hand on Harden's (LAC) side during his driving floater attempt and the contact is marginal.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a defensive goaltending violation by Butler III (GSW) is confirmed. Butler III illegally touches the ball after it reaches its apex and begins its downward flight with a chance to score. The basket is scored and possession is given to Golden State when play resumes.
Dunn (LAC) places and removes his hands from Curry (GSW) as the offensive player cuts away from Dunn to set the pick and the contact on the play is marginal.
Dunn (LAC) brings his right hand towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Butler III (GSW) during his drive in the paint.
Dunn (LAC) places and immediately removes his left hand from Butler III's (GSW) side as he begins his upward shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Powell (LAC) makes illegal contact with Podziemski's (GSW) head as he attempts to secure the rebound. The illegal contact occurs prior to Podziemski's left foot coming down out of bounds.
Curry (GSW) firms up over his right leg in Leonard's (LAC) path and marginal contact occurs as Leonard defends around the screen.

Replay review of the foul called on Dunn (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Dunn rests and immediately removes his forearm from Butler III's (GSW) side and the contact during the layup attempt is marginal. The basket is scored and play resumes with Los Angeles' possession.
Green (GSW) brings his right hand down towards the ball and legally brushes it prior to marginal brush contact occurring with Leonard's (LAC) right arm at the start of his dribble drive.
Green (GSW) momentarily grasps and promptly releases the back of Leonard's (LAC) jersey during his drive towards the paint and the contact is marginal.

Butler III (GSW) jumps straight up into the air and is in a legal vertical position when he absorbs the contact with Leonard (LAC) during the driving shot attempt. Butler III's body rotates as a natural reaction to absorbing the contact with Leonard in the air.
Leonard (LAC) releases the shot attempt and after it fails to make contact with the rim, is illegally the first player to touch it.
Payton II's (GSW) arms come out slightly as he attempts to firm up in Dunn's (LAC) path and marginal contact occurs as the two players come together during the pick.
Leonard (LAC) is leaning away from Green (GSW) when he absorbs the marginal contact with the offensive player during his shot attempt at the basket.
Butler III (GSW) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Podziemski (GSW) commits a take foul on Powell (LAC).
Green (GSW) commits a take foul on Leonard (LAC).
Powell (LAC) legally contests Hield's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Podziemski (GSW) commits a take foul on Harden (LAC).
